title: Profile Evaluation
description: Many people realise too late that they chose the wrong subjects or career. A profile evaluation starts that conversation early. We learn your interests, strengths, weaknesses, talents, ambitions and preferences, then sketch a career roadmap.
items: Mailers on subjects, courses and careers

title: Online Psychometric Testing
description: Take a career test online and get a report. Choose the test that matches the decision in front of you.
items: Subject Selector: which subjects suit you
Stream Selector: Science, Commerce or Humanities
Branch Selector: which specialisation or branch to pick
note: Career architecting isn't included. You can add sessions after you've seen the report.

title: Psychometric Assessment & Career Architecting
description: You take aptitude, interest and personality tests. A career architect then explains the report and turns it into decisions in two sessions.
items: Two career architecting sessions, about an hour each
Board and stream guidance for IB, IGCSE, CBSE and ICSE
Course and college guidance, India and international

title: Career Architecting Package
description: For students who want a career architect's guidance but don't need testing, often because they already have a direction in mind.
items: Two career architecting sessions, about an hour each
note: No psychometric tests. Choose the assessment package if you want them.

title: University Admission Package
description: For students deciding what comes after their bachelor's, and applying for a master's in India or abroad.
items: PG college guidance, India and abroad
Portfolio, SOP, resume and essay editing

category: Schools & colleges · online or on campus
title: Career Architecting Workshops
description: Workshops on the career questions your students and parents are asking, tailored to the age group and the decisions ahead.
